teams.blurb: Never a doubt. I don’t know the specific numbers but not many teams have averaged over 130 points in a single season in Preach Fantasy history, and after a massive performance in Week 10, Baylen looks like he’s on track to do just that. In the playoffs anything is possible, but I have a feeling no one wants to face this team in December.

teams.synopsis: Just like that he’s back up to the top of the rankings.
teams.blurb: Just like that he’s back up to the top of the rankings. Charlie dropped 186 points in a massive win against the team that beat him in the 2025 championship, I have a feeling the team was out for revenge. However, they will likely need to be at the top of their game once again in Week 11 to win against the hottest team in the league.

teams.synopsis: Definitely a down week for Aidan in Week 10, but he still broke 100 points, so his down weeks are continuing to be other team’s average weeks.
teams.blurb: Definitely a down week for Aidan in Week 10, but he still broke 100 points, so his down weeks are continuing to be other team’s average weeks. I really do think this could be the year for Aidan, and with a super easy Week 11 matchup this high ranking may be here to stay.

Could they be higher? For sure, but I think 4th is the perfect spot for now. Ryan is hitting his stride as we enter the final stretch of the regular season, as he has won three weeks in a row. However, Week 11 brings along a challenge as Ryan matches up against another top team in this edition of the rankings. Let’s see if the commissioner can keep his winning streak alive.

teams.synopsis: One of only three teams to have a 7-3 record, and Ben has a fine PPG, but I’m just not sold on a team that is this volatile and top heavy.
teams.blurb: One of only three teams to have a 7-3 record, and Ben has a fine PPG, but I’m just not sold on a team that is this volatile and top heavy. They get what shapes up to be an easier opponent in Week 11, so Ben may repeat as a top seed in the playoffs as he did in 2025, but don’t be surprised if they fail to make a deep run again due to the low floor they continue to show.

teams.synopsis: No change for Deniz this week.
teams.blurb: No change for Deniz this week. Honestly, I think Deniz should feel very comfortable with his positioning. He really only needs to win two more games in the final four weeks, but that looks very doable for how they’ve been playing. I think we see Deniz make the playoffs for the first time in a long time. It’s a pleasant sight to see this franchise competitive for a playoff spot in late November.

teams.synopsis: Welp, the team’s first loss since September came in sad fashion as Max lost to a team that put up only 78 points.
teams.blurb: Welp, the team’s first loss since September came in sad fashion as Max lost to a team that put up only 78 points. Still, this team has 7 wins and I think that may be enough to secure a playoff spot, even if they lose out. The team has been far from great, but they have a winning DNA. I have them ranked lower this week but don’t be surprised if they find more ways to win.

teams.synopsis: Despite dropping four straight matchups, I am moving Anthony back up the rankings this week.
teams.blurb: Despite dropping four straight matchups, I am moving Anthony back up the rankings this week. This is mostly because I just like his team rest of season to make a playoff push and he’ll sneak in again as a bottom seed. Then again, Week 11 is a crucial matchup that was almost picked as our Matchup of the Week because of the stakes. Let’s see what the defending champion has for us in Week 11.

teams.synopsis: Don’t really know what to think of my own team.
teams.blurb: Don’t really know what to think of my own team. On one hand, we won our Week 10 matchup, but we only put up 98 points. However, we now get back a few key players from BYE and Jordyn Tyson looks like the real deal. For now, borderline playoff team is the perfect description.

teams.synopsis: Yes, Quin has won the last two weeks, but I’m dropping them in rankings because Week 10 looked rough and Week 11 doesn’t look like it will be any better.
teams.blurb: Yes, Quin has won the last two weeks, but I’m dropping them in rankings because Week 10 looked rough and Week 11 doesn’t look like it will be any better. Still, Quin is in good position to make a playoff push, but only time will tell. The Drake Maye injury is brutal, but let’s see how the team responds.

teams.synopsis: Yeah, so trading away Davante Adams for David Montgomery is definitely a choice, but if it gets Andrew the win in Week 11 then whatever.
teams.blurb: Yeah, so trading away Davante Adams for David Montgomery is definitely a choice, but if it gets Andrew the win in Week 11 then whatever. I still think it will be a bad trade but to each their own. Andrew looks to make a late season playoff push after dropping three straight games, and Week 11 looks like it may get him back in the win column against a shorthanded opponent.

teams.synopsis: Where did that massive performance come from?
teams.blurb: Where did that massive performance come from? Carmine puts up 167 points in Week 10, but only moves up a single spot in the rankings, which I think is fair. The team now averages just 101 points a week, so even with the huge win last week I think the Rest Of Season outlook is dry. It starts with an easier matchup in Week 11 against a shorthanded A$AP Monke.

teams.synopsis: Well, I think Brandon just got away with robbery.
teams.blurb: Well, I think Brandon just got away with robbery. This evening Brandon traded David Montgomery for Davante Adams, however I have a feeling he will have to trade Davante Adams in the near future, especially if the star WR doesn’t suit up in Week 12. Anyway, Brandon plays a team he has never lost to but something tells me this meeting won’t be that easy.

This comes as no surprise. Cole has lost five in a row and is basically eliminated from playoff contention. He now shifts his efforts to avoiding last place and the league punishment. Puka trade may or may not be coming.

matchup_of_the_week.blurb: The Matchup of the Week for Week 11 was a tough one to choose, but ultimately, I went with the one where two top four ranked teams face each other. Ryan has been on fire, winning 3 straight games and scoring 160 points in his Week 10 win. Charlie’s been impressive too with 186 points in his win last week. Ryan has beaten Charlie four of the six time they’ve matched up, but this one looks like a toss-up to me as both teams project to score a good number of points, a classic shootout. Not only will this matchup determine who’s higher in the rankings for Week 12, but it will most likely have some major ramifications for the 2026 Playoff seeding. Good Luck to both teams!
